title: Gregory of Nazianzus: Oration 2, In Defence of His Flight
author: Gregory of Nazianzus
edition: Migne PG 35; Khazarzar Digital Patrology text, checked against the PG scan

text_history.method: New English from the Greek copy-text (Migne PG as typed by the Aegean Digital Patrology); the copy-text was diffed word by word against the OCR of the PG scan (50% word agreement, the rest OCR noise or listed in the collation). No published English used as wording.

witnesses.name: Migne PG text (Aegean University Digital Patrology, via Khazarzar)
Migne PG 35, archive.org scan patrologiae_cursus_completus_gr_vol_035 (Greek OCR)
witnesses.role: check (same print; OCR compared word by word)

text_history.quality_note: Word agreement with the PG scan is only 50%: the scan's Greek OCR runs the Latin translation column and the notes into the Greek, so many words have no clean partner. The copy-text itself is the typed Migne text; the collation lists every real difference.
